verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio is explicitly documented as a no-code, drag-and-drop tool for building/maintaining/updating workflows without developer involvement, and the Dashboard lets ops filter accepted documents by issuing country — both directly support code-free verification-logic configuration. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms conditional branching or risk-based routing logic within Workflow Studio, only general workflow building and document/country filtering. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditional-step/risk-based routing configuration, and independent/hands-on confirmation that template changes deploy live without engineering involvement.
